narration: Where does most ATP come from? Not glycolysis, and not the Krebs cycle.
It's the electron transport chain, on the inner mitochondrial membrane. H+ flows back through ATP synthase, which makes most of the ATP.
And the final electron acceptor at the end of that chain is oxygen.
